Napari plugin for extracting and unwrapping phase from Fringe Projection Profilometry images.

----------------------------------

This [napari] plugin was generated with [copier] using the [napari-plugin-template] (None).

## Installation

You can install `napari-profilometry` via [pip]:

```bash
pip install napari-profilometry
```

If napari is not already installed, you can install `napari-profilometry` with napari and Qt via:

```bash
pip install "napari-profilometry[all]"
```


To install latest development version:

```bash
pip install git+https://github.com/paolomaran/napari-profilometry.git
```



## Contributing

Contributions are very welcome. Tests can be run with [tox], please ensure
the coverage at least stays the same before you submit a pull request.
